title: Kidapawan mayor bars LGU Christmas parties outside province
summary: COTABATO CITY — Mayor Paolo Evangelista of Kidapawan City has banned city and barangay government officials from holding out-of-city and out-of-province Christmas parties and year-end…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Mayor Paolo Evangelista of Kidapawan City has banned city and barangay government officials from holding out-of-city and out-of-province Christmas parties and year-end gatherings to help the local economy. Evangelista issued Executive Order No. 81 on Monday, banning employees of the local government unit (LGU) from holding Christmas parties outside the city or North Cotabato province. “Christmas parties are part of our culture. I cannot, in good conscience, order the cancellation of all Christmas celebrations of the city LGU as well as the barangays,” Evangelista said in a video message posted on Facebook.
